page_title: TOR 1-0 EMP | Torino v Empoli 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' Today's match ends for Nikola Vlasic who will be replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Yann Karamoh (Torino) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
87' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) will deliver the corner kick.
86' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Liam Henderson is replaced by Ismael Konate (Empoli).
83' The VAR intervenes and the referee disallows the goal as Adam Masina (Torino) was in an offside position!
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Eljif Elmas as he is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
82' Attention! Referee Daniele Chiffi straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
81' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Adam Masina (Torino) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
79' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
79' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) sends a nice lofted cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort is plucked out of the air by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
78' Eljif Elmas (Torino) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
76' Here is a change. Junior Sambia is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
75' Empoli continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
74' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.

70' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Nikola Vlasic (Torino) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Marco Silvestri, so the score changes to 1:0.
67' It is time for a substitution. Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is on for Sebastiano Esposito.
66' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
66' Christian Kouame (Empoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Empoli get a corner.
64' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
63' Substitution. Gvidas Gineitis makes his way off the pitch and Valentino Lazaro (Torino) comes on as his replacement.
61' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
61' 8:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
58' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
57' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
56' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
54' Half-chance! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) plays a pass into the box, but Marco Silvestri reacts well to snuff out the attack.
52' Liam Henderson (Empoli) commits a foul and Daniele Chiffi immediately signals a free kick.
51' There's an opportunity for Liberato Cacace (Empoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
51' Junior Sambia (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Empoli.
49' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Chiffi had an easy-decision to make.
48' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
46' The referee signals a substitution. Adam Masina (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Sebastian Walukiewicz.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Chiffi starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The corner kick picks out Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
45+3' The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
40' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
40' Junior Sambia (Empoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
35' Alberto Grassi beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Junior Sambia (Empoli), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
33' Liam Henderson (Empoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Chiffi no option but to blow his whistle.
32' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
32' Torino win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
29' A cross by Christian Kouame (Empoli) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
28' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Empoli was in an offside position.

27' Saul Coco (Torino) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
26' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) is about to take a corner kick.
26' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Torino earn a corner.
25' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' Rough tackle by Luca Marianucci (Empoli). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' One of the players from Empoli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Liam Henderson (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Christian Kouame (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.
20' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
19' Neat passing move from Empoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Torino are ruled offside.
14' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post.
10' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
10' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. One of the players from Empoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
7' Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul after Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' Liam Henderson (Empoli) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
3' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Empoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Empoli will kick the game off.
Daniele Chiffi was nominated as the referee for this game.
